brief:
Occupation forces and settler militias launched a series of incursions, raids and attacks across West Bank cities and towns and Jerusalem overnight and into Friday morning, Shehab Wire reported. The operations resulted in injuries, arrests and the closure of roads and checkpoints throughout the territory.

Among those affected was a child who sustained wounds during the raids. The scale and timing of the assaults—concentrated in the predawn hours and continuing through the morning—marked an intensification of military and settler operations in occupied Palestinian territory. Specifics regarding the locations targeted, the number of those detained, and the extent of injuries remained under documentation.
